notes.title: v1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Changed how the colours are randomly selected for the obstacles in the Ship Graveyard. there are more colours to choose from, and it won’t choose a colour that is too similar to the player’s chosen colour
[*]Frigates in the Asteroid Field now have asteroids appear much closer than they used to
[*]Made adjustments to frigates to improve performance
[*]Fixed issue where the results screen would sometimes intersect with the stage if the player dies in certain places
[*]Certain elements of the leaderboards no longer show up before the scores have been loaded
[*]Fixed bug where time based missions could be completed after the player had died
[*]Added compatibility for DLC ships and stages
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added new music for the main menu and the Crystal Caves stage
[*]Added some adjustments and bug fixes to the ship selection menu
[*]Adjusted the hitboxes for the “Speed Cruiser” ship body, as well as the parts height on the ship select menu
[*]Fixed bug where the players scrap count wouldn’t always change after shuffling missions
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Implemented a better colour picker
[*]Made pickups slightly bigger
[*]Added more fuel pickups to the Ship Graveyard
[*]The first checkpoint in a checkpoint mission will now always spawn in front of the player
[*]Added and changed text in various menus
[*]The pause menu now shows you the current mission, as well as the challenge if one is active
[*]Changed how the lighting works in the Crystal Caves stage to hopefully improve performance
[*]Reduced particles in the main menu to improve performance
[*]Fixed bug where the default keyboard mapping for photo mode had some keys being used for multiple functions
[*]Fixed bug where the colour picker couldn’t be used with the mouse
[*]Fixed some of the colliders in the Ship Graveyard that were in the wrong places
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the game would sometimes soft lock or cause other issues when the Steam overlay is opened
[*]Fixed bug where score and challenge notifications were getting cut off in some aspect ratios
[*]Returning to the main menu from a stage now takes you straight to the mission select menu
[*]Added a back button to the ship selection menu
[*]Parts of the mission select screen no longer appear when the back or shuffle buttons are highlighted
[/list]
